{{Article header|deck=A defensive utility module that disables incoming seeker missiles, torpedoes, mines, and Hatch Breaker limpets in range.
}}

{{Article status|status=Needs review|mode=Both|version=Elite Dangerous, current Live and Legacy|reviewed=2026-08-20|reviewer=EDFM Engineer link-graph pass|source_quality=Well-established community consensus (INARA outfitting/engineering database), cross-checked against this wiki's already-cited Engineer articles}}

The '''Electronic Countermeasure''' (ECM) is a defensive utility module that disrupts hostile tracking munitions — [[Seeker Missile Rack|seeker missiles]], [[Torpedo Pylon|torpedoes]], mines, and Hatch Breaker limpets — throwing them off their target when triggered within range.

== Overview ==

Holding the trigger extends the ECM's effective radius, and there is no hard limit on how many separate hostile munitions it can disrupt in a single activation, making it a strong answer to a missile-heavy attacker or a pirate deploying [[Hatch Breaker Limpet Controller|Hatch Breaker limpets]]. Like other defensive utilities, it has a cooldown between uses rather than being available continuously.

{{Field note|ECM affects tracking munitions and limpets, not weapon fire itself. It does not stop laser or projectile damage, and it does not disrupt gimballed/turreted tracking the way a [[Chaff Launcher]] does.}}
